situation_en: You're on Metro Line 2 heading toward Tasqueña, on your way to the Zócalo. The train has just left Hidalgo when an announcement plays.

lines.speaker: Anuncio
lines.es: Próxima estación: Bellas Artes.
lines.en: Next station: Bellas Artes.

lines.speaker: Anuncio
lines.es: Estimados usuarios, les informamos que hoy domingo, por trabajos de mantenimiento, la estación Zócalo Tenochtitlan de la Línea Dos está cerrada.
lines.en: Dear passengers, today, Sunday, Zócalo Tenochtitlan station on Line 2 is closed for maintenance work.

lines.speaker: Anuncio
lines.es: Los trenes pasan por la estación, pero no se detienen.
lines.en: Trains pass through the station, but they do not stop.

lines.speaker: Anuncio
lines.es: Si usted va al Zócalo o al Centro Histórico, puede bajar en la estación Allende o en la estación Pino Suárez. Desde Allende son unos cinco minutos caminando.
lines.en: If you're going to the Zócalo or the Historic Center, you can get off at Allende or Pino Suárez. From Allende it's about a five-minute walk.

lines.speaker: Anuncio
lines.es: La estación Zócalo Tenochtitlan va a abrir otra vez mañana lunes a las cinco de la mañana, en su horario normal.
lines.en: Zócalo Tenochtitlan station is going to open again tomorrow, Monday, at 5 a.m., at its normal time.

lines.speaker: Anuncio
lines.es: Les recordamos que en horas pico los primeros vagones del tren son exclusivos para mujeres y niños menores de doce años.
lines.en: We remind you that at rush hour the first cars of the train are only for women and children under twelve.

lines.speaker: Anuncio
lines.es: Por su seguridad, no se recarguen en las puertas y dejen salir antes de entrar. Gracias por su comprensión.
lines.en: For your safety, don't lean on the doors, and let people off before you get on. Thank you for your understanding.

questions.prompt_en: Which station is closed today?
questions.hint_en: Listen for the station that comes before 'está cerrada'.
questions.explanation_en: 'La estación Zócalo Tenochtitlan de la Línea Dos está cerrada' = Zócalo Tenochtitlan station is closed. Allende and Pino Suárez are where you can get off instead, and Bellas Artes is just the next stop.

questions.prompt_en: You want to go to the Zócalo. What should you do?
options: Get off at Allende or Pino Suárez and walk
Stay on: the train stops at Zócalo for a moment
Get off at Bellas Artes and wait for the station to open
Change to the train going to Cuatro Caminos
questions.answer: Get off at Allende or Pino Suárez and walk
questions.hint_en: What do the trains do at the closed station, and where can you get off instead?
questions.explanation_en: Trains pass through Zócalo without stopping ('pasan por la estación, pero no se detienen'). The announcement says you can get off ('puede bajar') at Allende or Pino Suárez; from Allende it's about a five-minute walk. Heading to Tasqueña, Allende is the stop right after Bellas Artes.

questions.prompt_en: What time does Zócalo station open again tomorrow? (type it like 7:15)
questions.hint_en: Listen for 'va a abrir otra vez'. Type the time like 7:15.
questions.explanation_en: 'Va a abrir otra vez mañana lunes a las cinco de la mañana' = it's going to open again tomorrow, Monday, at 5:00 a.m.

questions.prompt_en: At rush hour, which cars are only for women and children under 12?
options: The first cars of the train
The last cars of the train
questions.answer: The first cars of the train
questions.hint_en: 'Horas pico' means rush hour. Listen for 'vagones'.
questions.explanation_en: 'En horas pico los primeros vagones del tren son exclusivos para mujeres y niños menores de doce años' = at rush hour the first cars are only for women and children under 12.

region_note: In the CDMX Metro, directions are named after the last station of the line (dirección Tasqueña). 'Horas pico' = rush hour (Spain: 'hora punta'). The ustedes commands at the end ('no se recarguen', 'dejen salir') are just for realism; no question depends on them.

situation_en: You booked a blood test at a clinic for Thursday. You missed a call this morning, and there's a voicemail.

lines.speaker: Buzón de voz
lines.es: Tiene un mensaje nuevo. Mensaje recibido hoy a las nueve y diez de la mañana.
lines.en: You have one new message. Message received today at 9:10 a.m.

lines.speaker: Recepcionista
lines.es: Buenos días, le hablo del laboratorio de la Clínica del Valle, sobre su análisis de sangre.
lines.en: Good morning, I'm calling from the Clínica del Valle lab about your blood test.

lines.speaker: Recepcionista
lines.es: El jueves el laboratorio está cerrado, entonces su cita cambia al viernes dieciséis a las ocho de la mañana. Tiene que llegar quince minutos antes para registrarse.
lines.en: On Thursday the lab is closed, so your appointment changes to Friday the 16th at 8 a.m. You have to arrive fifteen minutes early to check in.

lines.speaker: Recepcionista
lines.es: Es un estudio en ayunas: no puede comer nada desde las doce de la noche. Solo puede tomar agua; nada de café, ni jugo.
lines.en: It's a fasting test: you can't eat anything after midnight. You can only drink water; no coffee and no juice.

lines.speaker: Recepcionista
lines.es: Tiene que traer una identificación oficial y la orden de su médico. El estudio cuesta cuatrocientos veinte pesos, y puede pagar con tarjeta o en efectivo.
lines.en: You have to bring an official ID and your doctor's order. The test costs 420 pesos, and you can pay by card or in cash.

lines.speaker: Recepcionista
lines.es: Para confirmar, nada más tiene que mandar un WhatsApp a este mismo número. Los resultados van a estar listos el lunes en la tarde.
lines.en: To confirm, you just have to send a WhatsApp to this same number. The results are going to be ready on Monday afternoon.

lines.speaker: Recepcionista
lines.es: Muchas gracias. Que tenga buen día.
lines.en: Thank you very much. Have a nice day.

questions.prompt_en: When is your new appointment?
questions.hint_en: Listen for 'su cita cambia al...'.
questions.explanation_en: 'Su cita cambia al viernes dieciséis a las ocho de la mañana' = your appointment changes to Friday the 16th at 8 a.m. Thursday is the day the lab is closed. Dieciséis = 16 (seis would be 6).

questions.prompt_en: What time should you get to the clinic? (type it like 7:15)
questions.hint_en: Take the appointment time and count back the minutes she mentions.
questions.explanation_en: The appointment is at 8:00, and 'tiene que llegar quince minutos antes' = you have to arrive 15 minutes early, so 7:45.

questions.prompt_en: It's 7 a.m. on the day of the test. What can you have?
questions.hint_en: 'En ayunas' means fasting. What does she say you can drink?
questions.explanation_en: 'Solo puede tomar agua; nada de café, ni jugo' = you can only drink water; no coffee, no juice. 'En ayunas' = on an empty stomach.

questions.prompt_en: What do you need to bring?
options: An ID, the doctor's order, and $420
An ID, the doctor's order, and $240
Only an ID and $420 in cash
questions.answer: An ID, the doctor's order, and $420
questions.hint_en: Two things to bring, plus the price. Check the price carefully.
questions.explanation_en: 'Tiene que traer una identificación oficial y la orden de su médico' = bring an official ID and your doctor's order. 'Cuesta cuatrocientos veinte pesos' = 420 (not 240). You can pay by card or cash, so cash isn't required.

questions.prompt_en: How do you confirm the appointment?
options: Send a WhatsApp to the number that called you
Go to the clinic on Thursday
questions.answer: Send a WhatsApp to the number that called you
questions.hint_en: Listen for 'para confirmar'.
questions.explanation_en: 'Para confirmar, nada más tiene que mandar un WhatsApp a este mismo número' = to confirm, you just have to send a WhatsApp to this same number.

region_note: 'Le hablo de...' is the usual Mexican way to say 'I'm calling from...'. An 'identificación oficial' in Mexico is usually the INE card or a passport. 'Que tenga buen día' is a set phrase; no question depends on it.

title_en: WhatsApp from your landlord: plumber visit
situation_en: You told your landlord that the bathroom sink is leaking. This afternoon you get a WhatsApp from them.

media.text_es:
Hola, buenas tardes 👋 Te escribo por la fuga del lavabo del baño. Ya hablé con el plomero y va a ir mañana miércoles entre las 10 y las 12 del día.

¿Vas a estar en el depa? Si no puedes estar, no hay problema: deja las llaves con el conserje en la entrada y él le abre.

Por favor, saca las cosas que tienes abajo del lavabo, porque el plomero necesita espacio para trabajar.

Van a cortar el agua como una hora, entonces si quieres, llena una cubeta en la mañana.

Yo le pago directamente al plomero, tú no tienes que pagar nada.

Contéstame hoy antes de las 8 de la noche, porfa, para confirmarle la hora. ¡Gracias!
media.text_en:
Hi, good afternoon 👋 I'm writing about the leak in the bathroom sink. I already talked to the plumber, and he's going to come tomorrow, Wednesday, between 10 and 12 noon.

Are you going to be at the apartment? If you can't be there, no problem: leave the keys with the caretaker at the entrance and he'll let him in.

Please take out the things you have under the sink, because the plumber needs room to work.

They're going to cut off the water for about an hour, so if you want, fill a bucket in the morning.

I'll pay the plumber directly; you don't have to pay anything.

Please reply today before 8 p.m. so I can confirm the time with him. Thanks!

questions.prompt_en: When is the plumber coming?
questions.hint_en: Look for 'va a ir'.
questions.explanation_en: 'Va a ir mañana miércoles entre las 10 y las 12 del día' = he's going to come tomorrow, Wednesday, between 10 and 12 noon.

questions.prompt_en: You're at work from 9 to 2 tomorrow. What do you do?
options: Leave your keys with the building's caretaker
Ask the landlord to change the day
Leave the keys under the doormat
questions.answer: Leave your keys with the building's caretaker
questions.hint_en: Look for 'Si no puedes estar...'.
questions.explanation_en: 'Si no puedes estar, no hay problema: deja las llaves con el conserje en la entrada' = if you can't be there, leave the keys with the caretaker at the entrance, and he'll let the plumber in.

questions.prompt_en: What should you do before the plumber comes?
options: Take your things out from under the sink
questions.answer: Take your things out from under the sink
questions.hint_en: Look for the request that starts with 'Por favor'.
questions.explanation_en: 'Saca las cosas que tienes abajo del lavabo' = take out the things you have under the sink ('abajo de' is the Mexican 'debajo de'). The plumber needs room to work.

questions.prompt_en: The plumber finishes and asks you for money. What is right?
options: The landlord pays him; you don't pay anything
You pay and take it off the rent
You pay in cash and send a photo of the receipt
questions.answer: The landlord pays him; you don't pay anything
questions.hint_en: Look for 'pago' and 'pagar'.
questions.explanation_en: 'Yo le pago directamente al plomero, tú no tienes que pagar nada' = I'll pay the plumber directly; you don't have to pay anything.

questions.prompt_en: By what time do you have to reply today? (type it like 7:15)
questions.hint_en: Look for 'Contéstame'. Type the time like 7:15.
questions.explanation_en: 'Contéstame hoy antes de las 8 de la noche' = reply today before 8 p.m. (20:00).

region_note: Mexico: 'depa' (short for departamento), 'plomero' (Spain: fontanero), 'cubeta' (Spain: cubo), 'porfa' = casual please. The message uses tú commands (deja, saca, llena, contéstame).

title_en: Festival announcement: new set times and gates
situation_en: You're arriving at an electronic music festival in Mexico City on a rainy night. The hosts make an announcement on the big screens.

lines.speaker: Presentadora
lines.es: ¡Buenas noches, Ciudad de México! Bienvenidos al Festival Órbita. Tenemos cambios importantes, así que pongan atención.
lines.en: Good evening, Mexico City! Welcome to the Órbita Festival. We have important changes, so pay attention.

lines.speaker: Presentador
lines.es: Por la lluvia de esta tarde, el set principal de hoy no va a empezar a las once y media. Va a empezar a las doce y cuarto, en el escenario Luna.
lines.en: Because of this afternoon's rain, tonight's main set is not going to start at eleven thirty. It's going to start at twelve fifteen, on the Luna stage.

lines.speaker: Presentadora
lines.es: El escenario Sol va a cerrar a la una de la mañana, una hora antes de lo normal.
lines.en: The Sol stage is going to close at one in the morning, one hour earlier than usual.

lines.speaker: Presentador
lines.es: Si todavía no tienen su pulsera, la puerta tres está cerrada. Por favor, entren por la puerta cinco, al lado del estacionamiento.
lines.en: If you don't have your wristband yet, gate three is closed. Please come in through gate five, next to the parking lot.

lines.speaker: Presentadora
lines.es: Pueden recargar su pulsera en la taquilla con un mínimo de doscientos pesos. Los casilleros cuestan ciento cincuenta pesos por toda la noche.
lines.en: You can top up your wristband at the box office with a minimum of two hundred pesos. Lockers cost one hundred fifty pesos for the whole night.

lines.speaker: Presentador
lines.es: El agua es gratis en las estaciones de hidratación, al lado de los baños.
lines.en: Water is free at the hydration stations, next to the restrooms.

lines.speaker: Presentadora
lines.es: Al final, habrá camiones gratis al metro hasta las dos y media de la mañana.
lines.en: At the end, there will be free buses to the metro until two thirty in the morning.

lines.speaker: Presentador
lines.es: Si pierden a sus amigos, el punto de encuentro está enfrente de la rueda de la fortuna. ¡Disfruten la noche!
lines.en: If you lose your friends, the meeting point is across from the Ferris wheel. Enjoy the night!

questions.prompt_en: What time does the main set start now? (type it like 7:15)
questions.hint_en: Listen for 'va a empezar'. The first time you hear is the old one.
questions.explanation_en: It was going to be at 11:30 ('no va a empezar a las once y media'); now it starts 'a las doce y cuarto' = 12:15. Doce (12), not dos (2).

questions.prompt_en: You don't have your wristband yet. Which gate do you use?
options: Gate 5, next to the parking lot
Gate 2, across from the Ferris wheel
Gate 3, next to the parking lot
questions.answer: Gate 5, next to the parking lot
questions.hint_en: Listen for 'puerta'.
questions.explanation_en: 'La puerta tres está cerrada... entren por la puerta cinco, al lado del estacionamiento' = gate 3 is closed, so go in through gate 5, next to the parking lot.

questions.prompt_en: How much is a locker for the night?
questions.hint_en: Listen for 'casilleros'. Two amounts are said close together.
questions.explanation_en: 'Los casilleros cuestan ciento cincuenta pesos por toda la noche' = 150. The 200 is the minimum to top up your wristband.

questions.prompt_en: What changes for the Sol stage?
options: It closes at 1 a.m., an hour early
It closes at 2 a.m., as usual
It closes at 1 a.m., an hour late
questions.answer: It closes at 1 a.m., an hour early
questions.hint_en: Listen for 'escenario Sol' and 'antes de lo normal'.
questions.explanation_en: 'El escenario Sol va a cerrar a la una de la mañana, una hora antes de lo normal' = it closes at 1 a.m., an hour earlier than usual. The main set is on the Luna stage.

questions.prompt_en: Until what time are there free buses to the metro? (type it like 7:15)
questions.hint_en: Listen for 'camiones gratis'. Type it like 7:15.
questions.explanation_en: 'Habrá camiones gratis al metro hasta las dos y media de la mañana' = free buses until 2:30 a.m.

region_note: Mexico: 'camión' = bus, 'rueda de la fortuna' = Ferris wheel (Spain: 'noria'). The ustedes commands (pongan, entren, disfruten) are there for realism; the questions don't depend on them.

title_en: WhatsApp from a café: your matcha workshop moved
situation_en: You signed up for a matcha workshop at a small café in the Roma neighborhood. This afternoon the café sends you a WhatsApp.

media.text_es:
¡Hola! 🍵 Te escribimos de Café Hoja, sobre el taller de matcha.

Una disculpa: el sábado 10 no vamos a poder abrir, porque van a arreglar la luz en todo el edificio. Por eso cambiamos el taller al domingo 11, a las 11:30 de la mañana. Va a durar dos horas.

El taller cuesta $480 y ya pagaste $200 de anticipo, entonces te faltan $280. Puedes pagar en efectivo o con transferencia el mismo día.

Incluye tu propio batidor de bambú y una bolsa de matcha de 30 gramos para llevar. Ese día también vas a tener 15 por ciento de descuento en todas las bebidas.

Si el domingo no puedes, te regresamos tu anticipo completo, sin problema.

Por favor, confírmanos antes del viernes a las 6 de la tarde. ¡Te esperamos! 💚
media.text_en:
Hi! 🍵 We're writing from Café Hoja about the matcha workshop.

Our apologies: on Saturday the 10th we won't be able to open, because they're going to fix the electricity in the whole building. So we moved the workshop to Sunday the 11th, at 11:30 in the morning. It will last two hours.

The workshop costs $480 and you already paid a $200 deposit, so you still owe $280. You can pay in cash or by bank transfer on the day.

It includes your own bamboo whisk and a 30-gram bag of matcha to take home. That day you'll also get 15 percent off all drinks.

If you can't make it on Sunday, we'll give you your whole deposit back, no problem.

Please confirm before Friday at 6 p.m. See you there! 💚

questions.prompt_en: When is the workshop now?
questions.hint_en: Look for 'cambiamos el taller al...'.
questions.explanation_en: 'Cambiamos el taller al domingo 11, a las 11:30 de la mañana' = moved to Sunday the 11th at 11:30 a.m. Saturday the 10th is the day they can't open.

questions.prompt_en: How much do you still have to pay? Type the number.
questions.hint_en: Take the price and subtract what you already paid.
questions.explanation_en: It costs $480 and you already paid a $200 deposit ('anticipo'), so 'te faltan $280' = you still owe 280.

questions.prompt_en: What do you take home?
options: A bamboo whisk and 13 g of matcha
A cup and 30 g of matcha
A bamboo whisk and 30 g of matcha
questions.answer: A bamboo whisk and 30 g of matcha
questions.hint_en: Look for 'Incluye'.
questions.explanation_en: 'Incluye tu propio batidor de bambú y una bolsa de matcha de 30 gramos para llevar' = your own bamboo whisk and a 30-gram bag of matcha to take home. The 15 percent discount is only for drinks that day.

questions.prompt_en: You can't go on Sunday. What happens?
options: They give back your whole deposit
questions.answer: They give back your whole deposit
questions.hint_en: Look for 'Si el domingo no puedes'.
questions.explanation_en: 'Si el domingo no puedes, te regresamos tu anticipo completo' = if you can't on Sunday, they give you your whole deposit back.

questions.prompt_en: You must confirm before Friday at what time? (type it like 7:15)
questions.hint_en: Look for 'confírmanos'. Type it like 7:15.
questions.explanation_en: 'Confírmanos antes del viernes a las 6 de la tarde' = confirm before Friday at 6 p.m. (18:00).

region_note: Mexico: 'una disculpa' = our apologies, 'anticipo' = deposit, 'la luz' = the electricity. 'Confírmanos' is a tú command with 'nos' attached.
